title: Relationship between Protein-Induced Membrane Curvature and Membrane Thermal Undulation.
authors: Li, Xiangyuan; Fu, Lei; Zhang, Shan; Dong, Yi; Gao, Lianghui
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化MD研究锚定无序蛋白诱导膜弯曲与热波动的关系，涉及IDP与膜互作机制，但对象为膜而非PPI，方法为物理模拟，整体相关但缺互作轴。
abstract: This work studied the membrane curvature generated by anchored proteins lacking amphipathic helices and intrinsic morphologies, including the Epsin N-terminal homology domain, intrinsically disordered C-terminal domain, and truncated C-terminal fragments, by using coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. We found that anchored proteins can stabilize the thermal undulation of membranes at a wavelength five times the protein's binding size. This proportional connection is governed by the membrane bending rigidity and protein density. Extended intrinsically disordered proteins with relatively high hydrophobicity favor colliding with the membrane, leading to a much larger binding size, and show superiority in generating membrane curvature at low density over folded proteins.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用粗粒化分子动力学模拟，探讨了缺乏两亲性螺旋及内在形态的锚定蛋白（包括Epsin N端同源结构域、固有无序C端结构域及截短的C端片段）所引发的膜曲率变化。研究发现，锚定蛋白能够稳定膜的热波动，其稳定波长约为蛋白结合尺寸的五倍。这一比例关系受膜弯曲刚度和蛋白密度调控。具有较高疏水性的延伸型固有无序蛋白倾向于与膜碰撞，导致更大的结合尺寸，并在低密度条件下生成膜曲率方面优于折叠蛋白。
